Subject: Request: interim coverage / bridge letter to cover post-report period

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the earlier SOC2 packet — our audit team reviewed the Type II and noted the report end date is 2026-12-31. We have a procurement milestone at the end of June and need a brief bridge letter (or interim controls affirmation) confirming Redwood's controls coverage from 2027-01-01 through the present (or confirming no material changes).

Attached: Emberlyn requested template and our compliance checklist. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide: 1) a one-page bridge letter, and 2) any supporting artifacts (e.g., summary of control changes, whether any control exceptions since 2026-12-31)? Emberlyn legal prefers the letter include the report period, current date, and a sentence about no material changes or an explanation if there are.

If possible, we need a signed PDF by 2027-06-20. Happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Sara Holt
Senior Procurement Manager
Emberlyn Health

Vanessa / Priya — reviewed. Short answers:

- There have been no material changes to SOC2 controls applicable to the 5 trust service categories since 2026-12-31.
- We made two low-risk operational tweaks (calendar maintenance windows and a minor logging config change) in Feb and Apr 2027; both are documented and tested. No control exceptions.
- Security is comfortable with the following draft sentence: "Except as described below, Redwood Inference confirms that, to the best of its knowledge, there have been no material changes to the system and control environment covered by the referenced SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2026-12-31 through the date of this letter."

I attached redlines with precise language and suggested minimal legal caveats (we avoid providing forward-looking guarantees). If legal needs to sign, let me know and I will route.

Attachments: redlines_from_security.pdf
